patthana23.29:1.1: Nasekkhaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sekkho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana23.29:2.1: Nasekkhaṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevasekkhanāsekkho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.29:3.1: Nasekkhaṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pañca.
